svg.title: Blood Sample Tube
svg.desc: Original vector blood sample tube with a rounded collection vessel, stopper, whole-blood fill, writable label band, and editable semantic regions.
svg.metadata: {"source_asset": {"id": "core.sample.blood_tube", "name": "Blood Sample Tube", "category": "clinical-sample", "tags": ["blood sample tube", "blood collection tube", "whole blood", "clinical sample", "biospecimen", "sample container"], "description": "Original vector tall blood sample tube with a neutral sealed stopper, blank label band, uniform whole-blood column, visible meniscus, and rounded base.", "file": "svg/blood_sample_tube.svg", "source_type": "original_vector_draft", "license": "CC0-1.0", "provenance": "Original Figure Studio vector asset drawn from generic blood-collection-vessel topology; no proprietary library artwork, vendor-specific design, scraping, tracing, or protected asset recreation was used.", "style_family": "figure-studio-soft-line-v1", "review_status": "visual_reviewed_2026_07_19", "style_status": "soft_line_v1_clinical_sample_batch_1", "mvp_quality": "curated", "editable_region_count": 5, "reviewer_notes": "The tall non-tapered body, neutral stopper, blank label, uniform blood column, meniscus, and rounded base distinguish this from conical tubes and cryovials. Stopper color does not encode additive type; no patient origin, collection volume, anticoagulant, disease, processing, or assay readiness is implied.", "editable_color_regions": [{"id": "tube", "label": "Collection tube", "default": "#E8EEF7", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "stopper", "label": "Neutral stopper", "default": "#AEB9C4", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "blood", "label": "Whole-blood sample", "default": "#D96C57", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "label", "label": "Blank label band", "default": "#F7F9FC", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "outline", "label": "Tube, stopper, label, and meniscus outlines", "default": "#26323D", "paint": "stroke"}]}, "source_svg": "scientific-packs/core-biology/svg/blood_sample_tube.svg", "source_archive": "scientific-packs(1).zip", "output_style": "Style 4", "batch": "009", "source_metadata_is_unmodified": true, "source_review_status_applies_to_original_only": true}
